subject.title: fix(agents): prevent canceled and timed-out runs from staying stuck

question: After real interrupted-run evidence is attached, should the agent-runtime owner accept this terminal-outcome precedence and cleanup-error propagation as the canonical lifecycle policy?
rationale: The patch changes cross-source terminal-state ordering and teardown behavior for active sessions; tests establish intended cases, but the protected maintainer path requires owner confirmation of the durable runtime policy.

options.title: Require runtime proof and approve the canonical path
options.body: Keep the PR draft until it includes a redacted after-fix cancel or timeout run showing terminal release and successful admission of the next message, then review the lifecycle policy.

options.title: Request a narrower behavior boundary
options.body: Ask for a reduced patch if the owner wants to preserve existing callback-order semantics outside the specific force-clear and stuck-run cases.

recommendation.title: Require runtime proof and approve the canonical path
recommendation.body: Keep the PR draft until it includes a redacted after-fix cancel or timeout run showing terminal release and successful admission of the next message, then review the lifecycle policy.
